meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
demo.title: Demo
demo.intro: Move the app to any day and run the scenario cards. Every page and price follows this clock.
demo.clock.title: Clock
demo.clock.movedNote: The real day is {date}. Reset the clock to go back to it.
demo.clock.dateHint: Prices, quotes and invoices use this day until you reset the clock.
demo.clock.error: The clock could not be moved. Check the date and try again.
demo.cards.title: Scenario cards
demo.cards.intro: Each card gets a button that sets it up and runs it, as the features arrive.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change is written in the same database transaction as its audit row, so nothing changes without a record of who did it.
audit.caption: The {count} newest changes, newest first
audit.empty: Nothing has changed yet. Every change made in the app will appear here.
actor.label: Continue as
pricing.page.intro: Choose how long you lease and how much you pay at the start. The monthly price updates as you go, and every line below shows where it comes from.
pricing.calculator.title: Your lease
pricing.calculator.downPaymentHint: Paying more now lowers the monthly price.
pricing.calculator.quantityHint: Several items are financed together, which can move them into a cheaper band.
pricing.calculator.previewFailed: The price could not be updated. Try again in a moment.
pricing.calculator.notAvailable: This item is not available right now, so it cannot be quoted. You can still see its price.
pricing.calculator.submitFailed: The quote could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
pricing.breakdown.title: How your price is made
pricing.breakdown.none: Change the choices above to see a price.
pricing.compare.title: Compare the terms
pricing.line.totalIfReturn: Total if you give it back
pricing.hint.financed: The price minus what you pay at the start
pricing.hint.band: A bigger amount gets a lower factor; the factor already includes the interest
pricing.hint.net: Amount we finance × factor, rounded to the nearest cent
pricing.hint.perUnitRemainder: {count} of the items carry one cent more, so the shares add up exactly
pricing.hint.buyout: {percent} % of the amount we finance, VAT not included
pricing.hint.totalIfReturn: What you pay at the start + {months} monthly payments
pricing.hint.totalIfBuy: The same, plus the price to buy it at the end
pricing.vatEstimate: The totals use today's VAT rate. VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice's date, so a rate change would move them a little.
pricing.refusal.below_minimum: The amount to finance, {financedCents}, is below the smallest we lease ({minimumCents}).
pricing.refusal.above_maximum: The amount to finance, {financedCents}, is above the largest we lease ({maximumCents}). A bigger down payment brings it down.
pricing.refusal.unknown_term: A {termMonths}-month lease is not offered for this amount. Choose {terms} months.
pricing.refusal.no_price_list_on_date: There is no price list for {isoDate}.

pricing.refusal.asset_not_available: This item is not available right now.
